item.title: Contract for Event Lighting – Swansea Ampitheatre
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 25,000 Status: active Deadline: 2026-12-14T12:00:00+00:00
Swansea Council invites tenders from suitably qualified and experienced lighting contractors for the design, supply, installation, commissioning and programming of a permanent architectural lighting scheme for the Swansea Amphitheatre. The objective of the project is to enhance the visual appearance, identity and visitor experience of the amphitheatre through high-quality, energy-efficient architectural lighting. The lighting installation should accentuate key architectural features of the structure while remaining sympathetic to the surrounding environment and minimising light spill.
